name: MatrixMachineLearning
summary: This script implements a Hopfield-like recurrent neural network using MQL5 matrix operations to predict binary price direction from tick data. It trains a weight matrix on historical tick deltas, tests convergence on backtest and forward-test data, and outputs a binary forecast vector. It is a research/demo script and does not execute any trades.
summary_zh: 该脚本使用MQL5矩阵运算实现类Hopfield递归神经网络，基于tick数据的二值化价格变化方向进行预测。它在历史tick差值上训练权重矩阵，在回测和前瞻测试数据上验证收敛性，并输出二值预测向量。这是一个研究/演示脚本，不执行任何交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Hopfield联想记忆网络，将连续的价格变化差值二值化为+1/-1序列，作为神经元的输入模式。入场条件是通过训练权重矩阵（Hebbian学习规则，即权重为输入向量和响应向量的外积累加），然后在运行阶段通过前向和反向传播反复迭代直到网络收敛到稳态。出场条件在此脚本中不适用，因为它仅生成预测信号而不执行交易。仓位管理和资金管理完全缺失，脚本仅输出二值预测结果供人工或其他程序参考。该策略的创新之处在于将Hopfield网络应用于金融时间序列的二值化预测，但二值化会丢失大量价格幅度信息，且网络容量受限于预测器大小。收敛性不保证，设置了最大迭代次数限制（LIMIT=100），未收敛时仍输出结果。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a Hopfield associative memory network, binarizing continuous price change deltas into +1/-1 sequences as neuron input patterns. Entry conditions are derived by training a weight matrix using Hebbian learning (weights are the cumulative outer product of input and response vectors), then running forward and backward propagation iteratively until the network converges to a stable state. Exit conditions are not applicable in this script since it only generates prediction signals without executing any trades. Position sizing and money management are completely absent; the script merely outputs binary forecast vectors for human or programmatic reference. The innovation lies in applying Hopfield networks to binarized financial time series forecasting, but binarization discards significant price magnitude information and network capacity is limited by the predictor size. Convergence is not guaranteed—there is a maximum iteration limit (LIMIT=100), and results are output even when the network fails to converge.

pros: 使用MQL5原生矩阵运算实现神经网络，代码简洁高效
Hebbian学习规则训练权重，无需反向传播和梯度计算，计算成本低
提供回测和前瞻测试双重验证，有助于评估模型泛化能力
在线预测功能可实时获取新tick数据并生成预测
网络收敛检测机制（ACCURACY阈值和迭代上限）防止无限循环
pros_en: Uses native MQL5 matrix operations for neural network implementation, keeping code concise and efficient
Hebbian learning rule for weight training requires no backpropagation or gradient computation, keeping computational cost low
Provides both backtest and forward-test validation to help assess model generalization
Online prediction feature can fetch new tick data in real-time and generate forecasts
Network convergence detection (ACCURACY threshold and iteration cap) prevents infinite loops
cons: 二值化价格变化丢失了幅度信息，只保留方向，预测粒度粗糙
Hopfield网络存储容量有限，预测器维度增大时容易产生虚假稳态
没有任何交易执行逻辑，仅是研究演示脚本，无法直接用于实盘
缺少模型评估指标，仅用dot product匹配度衡量准确率不够严谨
未考虑交易成本、滑点、点差等实际交易因素
前瞻测试准确率仅58.5%，略高于随机水平，实际预测能力存疑
cons_en: Binarization of price changes discards magnitude information, retaining only direction, resulting in coarse prediction granularity
Hopfield network storage capacity is limited; increasing predictor dimensionality easily leads to spurious stable states
No trade execution logic whatsoever—it is only a research demo script, cannot be directly used in live trading
Lacks rigorous model evaluation metrics; using only dot product match count for accuracy is insufficient
Does not account for real trading factors such as costs, slippage, and spreads
Forward-test accuracy is only 58.5%, barely above random chance, casting doubt on actual predictive power
improvements: 引入更多特征（如成交量、多周期数据）替代单一二值化价格差，丰富输入信息
增加交叉验证和滑动窗口训练机制，避免过拟合并适应市场状态变化
添加完整的风险管理模块和交易执行逻辑，使其能真正用于自动交易
improvements_en: Introduce additional features (e.g., volume, multi-timeframe data) instead of single binarized price deltas to enrich input information
Add cross-validation and sliding window training mechanisms to avoid overfitting and adapt to changing market conditions
Add a complete risk management module and trade execution logic to enable actual automated trading

risk_points: 脚本不执行任何交易操作，仅生成预测信号，无直接资金风险
网络不收敛时仍输出结果，可能产生误导性预测信号
缺乏对输入数据有效性的充分验证（如tick数据不足时的处理较简单）
risk_points_en: The script does not execute any trades, only generates prediction signals, so there is no direct financial risk
The network outputs results even when it fails to converge, potentially producing misleading prediction signals
Insufficient validation of input data effectiveness (e.g., handling of insufficient tick data is simplistic)
